name: Kuji Sayaka
source:
Likes: Power, Fame
Dislikes: Useless subordinates, Her younger brother

She is a former model who has started up her own designer brand and manages her own store. However she acts in a superior way and looks down on those around her, due to that her popularity with her subordinates and those in the same line of work is nonexistent.
She is currently separated from her husband due to a miscarriage.
